transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well, I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining it. But I'm not. I know my wife’s relative has been coming into this house to get at me. 

I mean, I work in fabrication, I know exactly where I leave my things. My tools don’t just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don’t just get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been going on for months now, and I can see it plain as day. He’s been trying to take over my place and push me out.
Has there ever been a time when you thought this might not actually be happening?

No. I mean, like I was just saying... everyone else wants to tell me I'm just imagining things, but I'm the one living here. I don't doubt it because I see it happening. 

I know my own house. I know when my own tools have been messed with. When you find your gear moved around day after day, and your weekends ruined on purpose week after week... you don't really second-guess it anymore. It's been going on way too long to just be in my head. It's obvious to me what he's doing. He wants me gone so he can take over. So no, I haven't thought that, because the proof is right there in front of me.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people around you did not?

No, I haven't. I mean, I don't hear voices or see ghosts or anything like that, if that's what you're asking. I just see what's actually there. Like I said, I see my tools moved. I see the things he's messed with. It's not like I'm hallucinating it... the stuff is physically moved. Anyone could see it if they just bothered to look.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts are hard to follow?

No, no one has ever said that to me. I speak plain English. I'm pretty clear about what I'm saying, and people understand me just fine. They might not want to believe what I'm telling them about my house, but they understand the words coming out of my mouth. I don't get confused or lose my train of thought. I just tell it like it is.
Do you think this person can somehow enter your home without physically being there, like through special powers or impossible means?

No, nothing like that. He's not... he doesn't have magic powers or anything. He's just a guy. I don't know exactly how he's getting in—maybe he made a copy of my key somehow, or he's picking the lock when I'm at work. But he's physically coming into my house. It's not some supernatural thing. He's just sneaking in and messing with my stuff.
Do you think this person is able to control your thoughts or actions in any way?

No, definitely not. Nobody can control what I think or what I do. I'm my own man. Like I said, he's just a regular guy breaking into my place. He can't get inside my head or anything like that. That's impossible. My thoughts are completely my own, he's just... he's just messing with my physical property.
Have you had any periods where you felt unusually energetic or needed much less sleep than usual?

No, my sleep's been pretty normal. I mean, I get tired after a long shift at the plant just like anyone else. I definitely don't have extra energy, and I need my seven or eight hours of sleep to function. I haven't had anything like that going on.
Have these beliefs caused any problems with your work, relationships, or day-to-day life?

Well, it's definitely changed how I do things around the house. I mean, I've stopped leaving my tools and equipment out where I used to keep them. I spend a lot of time now just... locking things up, checking the workshop over and over to make sure it's secure. And I just try to avoid being anywhere near him when I'm at home. 

It's caused some problems, yeah. It's made things pretty tense with my wife, she doesn't really get why I'm doing all this. But as far as my job goes... I'm still getting to the plant on time, still getting my work done. I'm handling my day-to-day stuff fine, it's just... it takes a lot out of me, having to constantly secure my own home.
How long have you been sure that your wife’s relative has been coming into your house and messing with your things?
It's been going on for... about nine months now. Yeah, right around nine months. Basically, it started pretty much as soon as he moved into our home.
